Are you ready for a logistics role with real responsibility? 🚀 Where you don't just work on the floor, but also handle system administration on the PC and mentor new colleagues? Become a Senior Warehouse Operator at Samsung SDS! You will earn a great starting wage of €15.47 per hour. Read on and apply today!

What we offer
- An hourly wage of €15.47!
- Shift allowances on top of your pay!
- Weekly payout of your salary
- Free training to obtain MHE certificates!
- Growth opportunities toward coordinator!

Who you are
To get started as a warehouse operator, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You speak and write English fluently.
- You have at least 1 year of work experience in logistics.
- You are computer literate and skilled with system administration.
- You are available full-time to work in shifts
- You hold a valid MHE certificate or are willing to obtain one
- You are physically able to handle heavy items
- You can work at the job location in Breda

What will you do
As a warehouse operator at Samsung SDS, no two days are the same! You are much more than an average warehouse worker. One moment you ride MHE equipment to shift inventory, and the next you operate the system to inspect and process RMA returns. On top of that, you serve as a mentor guiding new colleagues on the floor!

- You accurately inspect and register returned goods (RMA) into the computer system.
- You drive MHE equipment safely to transport items through the warehouse.
- You train and guide new team members following company guidelines.

Where will you work
You will join an energetic, high-performing logistics team at Samsung SDS. Here, you work closely with supervisors and coordinators to hit key targets.

- Work at a world-renowned global logistics leader.
- Perfect mix of physical warehouse tasks and system management.
- Strong team spirit with short communication lines.

De Klok Dranken in Helmond is known for its assortment of beers, wines, and soft drinks. It is a dynamic company where teamwork is paramount. Together, you work towards providing the best service ever

From the port of Rotterdam to the government quarter in The Hague: everything runs on data centers, and those data centers run on power. You keep that power up.
UPS systems, battery banks and backup power: based in Rotterdam you work on the installations that keep servers up, even when the grid drops out. You replace battery modules, measure voltage and conductance, pull and label cables and record what you did, because in these buildings the documentation weighs as much as the work. You get into heavily secured sites in Rotterdam and The Hague, and sometimes beyond: Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Brussels. If you come from commercial and industrial buildings and UPS is new to you, you learn those systems here on the installation itself, alongside an experienced engineer. Physical, technical and precise, because a mistake is not an option here.
The essentials: Salary €3.300 to €4.100 per month · 40 hours per week · Fulltime · Based in Rotterdam.
In this role you earn €3.300 at entry, rising to €4.100 as an experienced engineer. Growing on to Senior can later reach €4.900, but you are applying now for the Data Center Engineer role.
What you bring
- Solid experience as an electrical engineer in commercial and industrial buildings, for example offices, healthcare, industry or data centers
- MBO 3 Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience
- Knowledge of UPS and backup power systems, extensive experience with them is a welcome plus
- NEN 3140 VP and VCA VOL, or the willingness to obtain them
- Driver's license B
- You can work independently
- English at working level is a plus
- Willing to work abroad (regularly Benelux, occasionally further)

What we offer
- Manufacturer training on UPS systems from Eaton and Schneider Electric
- NEN 3140 and VCA certification if you don't have them yet
- The opportunity to obtain NEN 3840 (high voltage)
- LOTO and ESD training
- International work in Europe's most secure data centers
- Metal & Engineering CAO with travel allowance

An end-of-year bonus, based on company results. €0.21 per kilometre travel allowance, starting from 10 km one way. Extensive training and development opportunities. The opportunity to work in a highly advanced and innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These machines play a crucial role in the production of microchips, which are used in virtually all modern technologies. As an Assembler, you are an essential part of this process. Your craftsmanship, precision, and attention to detail ensure that complex components and systems are assembled correctly and meet ASML's high quality standards. Every component you assemble contributes to a larger system, and every system contributes to the technology that enables the next generation of microchips. Your hands. Your craftsmanship. Your impact on the technology of tomorrow.
